note: What a placed template may contain of the blocks in data/spawn_blocks.json. Everything else fails validation: a donor's roof must not decide a town's encounters. Substitutions are applied to the template itself by tools/spawn_blocks.py substitute, so the fix travels with the asset and is not rediscovered per placement.

substitutions.why: Cobbleverse spawns varoom and revavroom on all 16 vanilla concrete colours in every overworld biome (data/spawn_blocks.json). The Moar Concrete block is not named by any spawn condition.
substitutions.visually: the mod's texture file is byte-identical to the vanilla one (16x16 RGBA) and its model is minecraft:block/cube_all, so nothing changes on screen
substitutions.dependency: moarconcrete, already a world-critical component of this pack

substitutions.visually: the mod's texture file is byte-identical to the vanilla one (sha256 c5c9faa80b7d..., both), and its model is minecraft:block/cube_all, so nothing changes on screen. Added 2026-09-17 for the Cobbleverse Brock gym, which is mostly brown concrete (566 blocks).

whitelist.why: the only spawns conditioned on it (carbink, corsola galarian, cursola, duraludon, archaludon and their herds) require #cobblemon:nether/is_quartz biomes. In an overworld town it has no effect.

terapagos needs #cobblemon:is_cave, which is dripstone and lush caves plus #c:is_cave and #c:is_underground. The Displaced City cavern is filled with minecraft:cherry_grove, so the Pokemon Center's amethyst does nothing there.
whitelist.scope: overworld and the cherry-grove cavern; a placement left in a cave biome would need checking again

whitelist.why: rotom is drawn to the machines a Pokemon Center is made of. That is the encounter the building should create, and it is deliberate.
apricorn trees draw electrode hisuian. A town that grows apricorns should get them.

flabebe and its kin are drawn to flowers, and several herds to leaves. Foliage objects and gardens are supposed to be foliage: this is the forest reading as forest, not a donor's roof deciding a town.
whitelist.scope: foliage objects, gardens and landmark trees

whitelist.why: the furniture of a village house. Whatever is drawn to a bed or a rug belongs in a bedroom, and a town whose houses have no beds reads as a film set.
whitelist.scope: houses in Brock's and Misty's towns (Repurposed Structures village interiors)

whitelist.why: the farm lots are meant to be farms. A crop drawing the Pokemon that like crops is the lot doing its job.
the meeting point on Brock's approach carries a village bell, which is what makes it read as a gathering place rather than an empty square.

Misty's town is built from the ocean village set and stands on the shore: its houses carry water, sand and coral, and water spawns inside a water town are the point of putting it there. Deliberate, and worth re-reading if any of these templates is ever reused inland.

the planting around a Pokemon Centre. The same argument as the flowers already whitelisted: a garden drawing the Pokemon that like gardens is the garden doing its job, and a Centre with a bare verge would look abandoned.
whitelist.scope: the CobbleTowns Centre and Mart gardens

whitelist.why: the decoration inside the ocean village houses Misty's town is built from: coral on a shelf, kelp in a jar, a redstone block in a workshop. The same argument as the brain coral already listed, and one of each: a water town that owns no coral would be odd.
one of each inside the two civic buildings, placed whole by resource id. A Rotom drawn to the observatory's monitor in the psychic town is flavour, not a leak
whitelist.consequence: a Rotom by the monitor, a Spinarak or Ariados by the web, garden Pokemon by the flower, in those two buildings
whitelist.decided: 2026-09-21, approved by the owner: a Rotom in the monitor room and a Spinarak in the cobweb are features

whitelist.scope: the Rift dig camp's tents (Repurposed Structures badlands and desert tent1)
whitelist.why: the tents are canvas, and wool is the only canvas there is; the camp is an outpost off Victory Road
whitelist.decided: 2026-09-21, by the implementing session under the owner's standing instruction to decide and record; on the review list

whitelist.scope: the Rift dig camp's excavation (Mega Showdown archaeological_site a and b)
whitelist.why: the dig is sand, and its suspicious sand carries the brushable finds; substituting it would wipe the loot tables, which are the point of a dig; the site's own mine-cart track, 6 rails in each
whitelist.consequence: whatever spawns on or near sand, in the excavation only
whitelist.decided: 2026-09-21, by the implementing session under the owner's standing instruction to decide and record; on the review list
